remarks: Move-in-ready, fully renovated 4-bedroom rental featuring a bright, open floor plan and a brand-new granite kitchen with a center island. The home offers living space, including a finished lower level with a private entrance, 2-bedrooms, full bath, and family room. Highlights include central air, gas cooking, a detached garage, and a deep, level fenced-in yard. Perfectly located near Route 7, I-95, and local shopping. Available for immediate occupancy. Easy to show.
